questions.q: If the radius of a sphere is increased by $125\%$ then by what percentage will its surface area increase?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, aise karna hai... $125\%$ ka fraction hota hai $\frac{5}{4}$. Matlab radius 4 thi, toh 5 badh kar 9 ho gayi. Surface area 2D hota hai, toh seedha square kar de: $4^2$ se $9^2$ yani 16 se 81 ho gaya. Kitna badha? 65 badha 16 par. Percentage = $\frac{65}{16} \times 100$. Ab pura solve mat kar, $\frac{6500}{16} = 406.25\%$.

DimensionEffect
1D (Radius, Side)Ratio $a : b$
2D (Area, Surface)Ratio $a^2 : b^2$

Summary: 1D se 2D aane ke liye hamesha square ratio use kiya kar, calculation fractional form me asaan ho jayegi.

questions.q: In an election between three candidates, the third-placed candidate received 1000 valid votes. From the remaining votes, the elected candidate received 5000 more votes than the runner-up candidate, accounting for $52\%$ of the total votes cast. If $16\%$ of votes were declared invalid (given that all the voters cast their vote), then the total number of cast votes was?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, Total cast votes ko $100x$ maan le. Invalid hue $16x$, toh Valid bache $84x$. Winner (W) ko mile $52x$. Teeno ka sum valid votes hota hai: $W + R + T = 84x$. Yaha $T = 1000$ aur $W = 52x$ rakh de. Runner-up (R) aayega $84x - 52x - 1000 = 32x - 1000$. Question me diya hai $W = R + 5000$. Toh $52x = (32x - 1000) + 5000$. Solve karega toh $20x = 4000 \Rightarrow x = 200$. Total votes $100x = 20000$.

Trick: Variables ko total ke percentage ke terms me hi chalne do end tak.

Summary: Election wale questions me tree diagram dimaag me set rakh: Cast -> Valid -> Distribution.

questions.q: In a certain college, each of 240 students can speak at least one language. The total number of Hindi speaking students are $(2x+10)\%$ and the total number of urdu speaking students are $(x+20)\%$. If $(x-10)\%$ of total students can speak both the languages, then find students who speak only urdu is what percent of the students who speak only Hindi.
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, set theory ka union formula laga $A \cup B = A + B - (A \cap B)$. Yaha total $100\%$ hai. Toh $100 = (2x+10) + (x+20) - (x-10)$. Solve karne par $100 = 2x + 40$, toh $x = 30$ aagaya. Hindi wale hue $70\%$, Urdu hue $50\%$, Both hue $20\%$. Only Hindi = $70 - 20 = 50\%$. Only Urdu = $50 - 20 = 30\%$. Required percentage = $\frac{30}{50} \times 100 = 60\%$.

Best Approach: 240 number sirf darane ke liye diya hai, percentages me khelna fast hai.

Summary: Venn diagram banane ki zarurat nahi agar formula dimag me clear ho.

questions.q: A student scored $20\%$ more marks in Math than in Science. If the average of his marks in both subjects is 66, what are his marks in Science? (CHSL TIER I-$\frac{15}{11}$/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, $20\%$ ka ratio hota hai $\frac{1}{5}$. Agar Science me 5 unit hai, toh Math me 6 unit hoga. Total hue 11 unit. Average 66 hai toh Sum = $66 \times 2 = 132$. 11 unit ki value 132, toh 1 unit = 12. Science ke marks = 5 unit = $5 \times 12 = 60$. Ekdum mental math wala sawaal!

Summary: Fraction aur unit method se average ke basic questions seconds me nikal jate hain.

questions.q: In a state election between two parties, $83\%$ of the voters cast their votes, out of which $4\%$ of the votes were declared invalid. Party A got 156611 votes which were $83\%$ of the total valid votes. Find the total number of votes enrolled in that election. (Consider integer part only)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, linear equation bana: $Total \times 0.83 \times 0.96 \times 0.83 = 156611$. Pura calculation karne baithega toh exam khatam ho jayega! Approximation laga: $0.83 \times 0.83$ lagbhag $0.69$ hota hai. Uska $0.96$ times lagbhag $0.66$ banega (yani $2/3$ ke thoda paas). Toh $\frac{156000}{0.66}$ nikal. Ans $236000$ ke kareeb aayega. Options dekh ke seedha tick maar de 2,36,807.

Trick: CGL me jab calculation aisi gandi ho, toh options dekho. Hamesha door-door hote hain ya pattern pakadne ke liye set kiye jate hain.

Summary: Decimal multiplication me approx values leke nearest option mark karna smart strategy hai.

questions.q: A company allowed $16\%$ commission on the total sales made by salesman and a bonus of $6\%$ on the sales over 7000. If the salesman deposited $\text{Rs. } 8610$ in the company after deducting his earning from the total sales made by him. Find total sales?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, ye 'Shift Method' ka king question hai. Maan le company usko pehle 7000 par bhi $6\%$ extra bonus de deti, toh uski kamai $6\%$ of $7000 = \text{Rs. } 420$ badh jati. Agar wo 420 zyada rakhta, toh company ko 420 kam deta. Naya deposit = $8610 - 420 = 8190$. Ab use poore par $16+6 = 22\%$ mil raha hai, yani company ko $78\%$ mil raha hai. $78\%$ ki value 8190 hai, toh $100\% = \frac{8190}{0.78} = 10500$.

ConceptLogic
Income ShiftingHypothetically make the commission percentage uniform across the entire amount to easily find the base total.

Summary: Uniform rate banane ke liye imaginary cash ka len-den karo, seedha ek single percentage aayega.

Dekh bhai, fractions pe pakad achhi honi chahiye! $80\%$ of 350 = 280. $37.5\%$ standard fraction hota hai $\frac{3}{8}$. Toh $\frac{3}{8} \times 160 = 60$. $11\%$ of 500 seedha 55 hai. Ab jod-ghatao kar: $280 - 60 + 55 = 220 + 55 = 275$.

Trick: Zeroes se dar mat, percentage ka 00 cancel kar ke seedha multiply kara kar.

Summary: Standard fraction values tips pe hone se aise questions me pen rukta nahi hai.

questions.q: In an examination every question correctly answered fetches two marks and for every question wrongly answered one mark is deducted. Anusha and Preet took the examination. Anusha attempted a certain number of question and $20\%$ of them went wrong. Preet attempted a certain number of questions and $10\%$ of the questions attempted by him went wrong. Anusha got 33 marks more than the pass mark and Preet got 48 marks more than the pass mark. Anusha and Preet together attempted 100 questions. What is the pass mark of the examination?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, Net score nikalna seekh. 1 sahi ka 2 mark, 1 galat ka -1. Anusha ki $80\%$ accuracy hai. Net marks per question = $0.8(2) - 0.2(1) = 1.4$. Preet ki $90\%$ accuracy hai. Net = $0.9(2) - 0.1(1) = 1.7$. Dono ke marks ka difference = $48 - 33 = 15$. Yani $1.7P - 1.4A = 15$. Sath hi diya hai $P + A = 100$. $P = 100 - A$ rakh ke solve karega toh $A = 50$ aayega. Anusha ke total marks = $1.4 \times 50 = 70$. Pass marks = $70 - 33 = 37$.

Best Approach: Har attempt ko average marks per question ki tarah treat karna best trick hai yaha.

Summary: Negative marking me net expected value nikal loge toh lambi calculation se bach jaoge.

questions.q: A shopkeeper at Garbar Jhala, Aminabad first increases the price of an ornament by x%, then he decreases the new price by x%. After one such up-down cycle, the price of the ornament decreases by $\text{Rs. } 21025$. After the second up-down cycle, the ornament is sold for $\text{Rs. } 484416$. What was the original price of the ornament?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, ye CDS level ka ghumao hai! Hamesha yaad rakhna x% up and x% down means loss. Agar mai Original Price 5,25,625 lu, aur pehle cycle me drop 21025 ho. Toh drop percentage kitna hai? $\frac{21025}{525625} = \frac{1}{25} = 4\%$. Yani ek cycle ka multiplier $0.96$ hai. Cycle 1 ke baad price = $525625 - 21025 = 504600$. Isko wapas $0.96$ se multiply kar. Naya price = $504600 \times 0.96 = 484416$. Match ho gaya!

Trick: Options se base uthao aur dekho ki drop ek simple percentage fraction ban raha hai ya nahi.

Summary: Complex compounding me reverse engineering from options is the only way to save time.

questions.q: A fraction is reduced such that when it is squared and then its numerator is increased by $20\%$ and denominator is reduced by $25\%$, it results in $\frac{6}{5}$ of the original fraction. The product of the numerator and denominator is?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Maan le original fraction F hai. Equation bana: $F^2 \times \frac{1.20}{0.75} = \frac{6}{5} F$. Ek F cut jayega. Bacha $F = \frac{6}{5} \times \frac{75}{120}$. Isko kaat peet: $\frac{6}{5} \times \frac{5}{8} = \frac{6}{8} = \frac{3}{4}$. Numerator 3, Denominator 4. Dono ka product $3 \times 4 = 12$.

Best Approach: Simple percentage change ko equation me dal ke seedha kaat de.

Summary: Fractions me percent change aaye toh unhe decimal ya common fraction me rakh ke cut karna asaan hota hai.

questions.q: In a co-educational school there are 15 more girls than boys. If the number of girls is increased by $10\%$ and the number of boys is also increased by $16\%$, there would be 9 more girls than boys. What is the number of students in the school ?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, basic linear equation ka sawal hai. Shuru me $G = B + 15$. Nayi condition: $1.1G - 1.16B = 9$. G ki jagah $(B + 15)$ rakh de. Toh $1.1(B + 15) - 1.16B = 9$. Solve karega toh $-0.06B + 16.5 = 9$, jahan se $0.06B = 7.5$ aayega. $B = \frac{7.5}{0.06} = 125$. Toh $G = 125 + 15 = 140$. Total = $125 + 140 = 265$.

Trick: Base assumptions check kar sakte ho. Total options me 265 hai. 265 ko do parts me todo jinka diff 15 ho (125 aur 140). Fir verify kar lo mentally!

Summary: Aise linear cases me equations banane me hardlly 10 second lagte hain, wahi best hai.

questions.q: Ramesh can save $30\%$ of his income but after 4 years, his income increases by $42\%$ and he still manages to save the same amount as before. What is the percent increase in his expenditure ?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, 100 maan ke udau isko! Income 100 thi, Save 30 kiya, Kharcha 70 hua. Ab income ho gayi 142. Savings abhi bhi wahi 30 hai. Toh naya kharcha = $142 - 30 = 112$. Kharcha 70 se 112 ho gaya. Kitna badha? 42. Base kya tha? 70. Percentage = $\frac{42}{70} \times 100 = 60\%$.

Best Approach: Direct deviation. Jab income badhi aur saving same hai, matlab saari badhi hui income kharche me gayi! $\frac{42}{70} = 60\%$. Pen uthane ki bhi zaroorat nahi.

Summary: Constant savings ke case me Change in Income hamesha Change in Expenditure ke barabar hota hai absolute value me.

questions.q: A, B and C contested an election. All the votes polled were valid. A got $38\%$ of the total votes. For every 45 votes polled, B got 18 votes. The winner got 5,760 more votes than the person who received the least number of votes. The total number of votes polled was:
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, percentages nikal lo sabka. B ko har 45 me se 18 vote mile, yani $\frac{18}{45} = \frac{2}{5} = 40\%$. A ke paas $38\%$ hain. Toh C bacha $100 - (38+40) = 22\%$. Winner B ($40\%$) hai, aur least C ($22\%$) hai. Inka gap hai $18\%$. Diya hai $18\% = 5760$. Toh $1\% = 320$. Total $100\% = 32000$.

Trick: B ka fraction dekhte hi dimag me $40\%$ strike karna chahiye.

Summary: Jab total values share ho rahi hon, toh sabko percentages ke ek common scale par le aao calculation easy ho jayegi.

questions.q: The sum of $25\%$ of a number and $40\%$ of the same number is 325. What is $120\%$ of that number? (PHASE XIII(GRAD) - $\frac{29}{07}$/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, isme toh number nikalne ki bhi aukaat nahi puchi. $25\% + 40\% = 65\%$. Yani $65\%$ ki value 325 hai. $65 \times 5 = 325$ hota hai, toh $1\% = 5$. Pucha $120\%$ hai. Toh $120 \times 5 = 600$.

Best Approach: Unitary method without finding the $100\%$ base.

Summary: CGL me aise traps aate hain jaha bache pehle original number nikalte hain fir required value, seedha multiplier lagao.

questions.q: Last year, Geeta's monthly salary was 12,000 and Seeta's monthly salary was 10,000. This year, Geeta's monthly salary is $\text{Rs. } 14$,400, while Seeta's monthly salary is $\text{Rs. } 12$,500. If the percentage increase in Seeta's monthly salary this year over her monthly salary last year is denoted by x%, and the percentage increase in Geeta's monthly salary this year over her monthly salary last year is denoted by y%, then what is the value of ((x-y)/y * 100) % ?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Geeta 12k se 14.4k gayi, badhotari hui 2.4k ki. $y = \frac{2.4}{12} \times 100 = 20\%$. Seeta 10k se 12.5k gayi, badhotari 2.5k. $x = \frac{2.5}{10} \times 100 = 25\%$. Nikaalna kya hai? $\frac{x - y}{y} \times 100$. Yahan values put kar: $\frac{25 - 20}{20} \times 100 = \frac{5}{20} \times 100 = 25\%$.

Trick: Zeroes ignore kar. 12 se 14.4 (1.2 times yani $20\%$) aur 10 se 12.5 (1.25 times yani $25\%$).

Summary: Aise lambe statements ko short chunks me process kar ke directly variable values find out karo.

questions.q: A salesman gets commission on total sales at $9\%$. If the sale is exceeded 10,000 he gets an additional commission as bonus of $3\%$ on the excess of sales over 10,000. If he gets total commission of 1380, then the bonus he received is:
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, Shift method zindabad! Maan le usko shuru ke 10,000 pe bhi $3\%$ bonus mil gaya. Toh uska commission Rs. 300 aur badh jata. Naya imaginary total commission = $1380 + 300 = 1680$. Ab use poore sales pe $9+3 = 12\%$ mil raha hai. $12\% = 1680$, toh $1\% = 140$. Total sales = 14000. Bonus sirf 10000 ke oopar milta hai yani 4000 pe. $3\%$ of $4000 = \text{Rs. } 120$.

Best Approach: Hypothetical equal percentage assumption method.

Summary: Commission wale saare types ek uniform percentage create karke aasani se tode jaa sakte hain.

questions.q: A metallic conical bowl with base radius 10 cm and height 24 cm is uniformly heated, increasing all dimensions by $10\%$. By how much does the volume increase? (CHSL TIER I - $\frac{30}{11}$/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, isme 10 cm aur 24 cm sirf trap hain! Volume hamesha 3D unit hota hai ($r^2 h$). Jab sabhi dimensions $10\%$ (yani multiplier $1.1$) badh jayein, toh volume $1.1 \times 1.1 \times 1.1 = 1.331$ ho jayega. 1 se 1.331 hona yani seedha $33.1\%$ ka increment! Pen uthane ka gunah mat karna yaha.

Dimension MultiplierNet Volume Multiplier
$10\%$ increase (1.1)$33.1\%$ increase (1.331)

Summary: Geometric properties me uniform scaling scale factor ke cube ke barabar hoti hai.

questions.q: The monthly income of three persons A, B and C amounts to $\text{Rs. } 57$,000. They spend $70\%$, $75\%$ and $80\%$ of their respective incomes and save the remaining. The ratio of their savings is 4:5:6. Find the monthly income of C.
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, Savings percentage nikal. A = $30\%$, B = $25\%$, C = $20\%$. Inki ratio 4:5:6 di hai. Incomes ki ratio nikalne ke liye savings ki absolute ratio ko percentages se divide kar de. $A = \frac{4}{0.3} = \frac{40}{3}$. $B = \frac{5}{0.25} = 20$. $C = \frac{6}{0.2} = 30$. Ratio banegi $40/3 : 20 : 30$, 3 se multiply karke simplify kar le = $40:60:90$ yani $4:6:9$. Total ratio sum = 19. 19 unit = 57000. 1 unit = 3000. C ki income (9 unit) = $9 \times 3000 = 27000$.

Trick: Income = Savings Ratio / Savings Percentage. Ekdum direct hit!

Summary: Jab absolute numbers ka ratio and percentages diye hon toh equivalent factors nikalke scale up karna asaan hota hai.

questions.q: The population falls by $12\%$ in the first year. By what percentage must it increase in the second year so that at the end of the second year the population is exactly the same as the original? (CHSL TIER I - $\frac{18}{11}$/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, 100 maan le. Pehle saal $12\%$ giri, toh 88 bachi. Ab wapas original laana hai, toh 88 ko 100 banana hoga. Kitna badhayega? 12. Kispe badhayega? Base ab 88 hai. Percentage = $\frac{12}{88} \times 100 = \frac{3}{22} \times 100 = \frac{150}{11}$. Solve karega toh $13.6363...\%$ aayega. Options me closest 13.6% hai.

Best Approach: Inverse percentage method. Drop hua hai $x/y$, toh wapas aane ke liye $x/(y-x)$ ka formula bhi lag sakta hai.

Summary: Base change concept me hamesha dhyaan rakha karo ki ab operation nayi value (88) par hoga, original 100 par nahi.

questions.q: Due to an increase of $32\%$ in the price of pulse, a person reduces his consumption in such a way that his expenditure increases only by $10\%$. If he consumes 150 kg of pulse after the price has increased, then how much pulse was consumed by him initially?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, ekdum killer trick! Initial/Final Consumption ka ratio = $\frac{(100 + \text{New Expenditure } \%)}{(100 + \text{New Price } \%)}$. Yaani $\frac{110}{132} = \frac{5}{6}$. Initial consumption 6 unit thi, toh Final 5 unit. Diya hai ki final 150 kg hai, toh 5 unit = 150. 1 unit = 30. Initial pucha hai (6 unit), toh $6 \times 30 = 180$ kg.

Trick: Price aur Expenditure dono percentage form me diye ho toh seedha 100 se relation dhoondho ratio banane ke liye.

Summary: Price-Consumption relation me ye relative deviation trick lagane se fraction ban jati hai and lamba solution bypass ho jata hai.

questions.q: Population a city increases by $41\frac{2}{3}\%$, 92000 in first and second year respectively but, in third year it decreases by $10\%$ and now population is thrice of initial population. Find the total increment in the population during the first year?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, mixed percentages aur absolute values ka tagda combo hai. $41\frac{2}{3}\%$ ka fraction $\frac{5}{12}$ hota hai. Calculation asaan banane ke liye Initial Population ko $12x$ maan le. Year 1 badhkar ho gayi $17x$. (Yahi $5x$ hume nikalna hai!). Year 2 me ho gayi $17x + 92000$. Year 3 me $10\%$ ghir gayi yani $0.9$ (multiplier) bachi. Final: $0.9(17x + 92000) = 3 \times 12x$ (thrice of initial). Isko solve karega: $17x + 92000 = 40x$. Toh $23x = 92000 \Rightarrow x = 4000$. Year 1 increment ($5x$) = $5 \times 4000 = 20000$.

Best Approach: Fractional base ko total initial assume karna calculation halwa kar deta hai.

Summary: Variables waha introduce karo jaha absolute aur percentage mix ho jayein aapas me equations balance karne ke liye.

questions.q: In a survey conducted at a university, it was found that $55\%$ of the students like Mathematics, $45\%$ like Physics, and $30\%$ like both Mathematics and Physics. Among the remaining students, $25\%$ prefer Computer Science, while the rest have no preference. If the total number of students surveyed is 800, how many students had no preference for any of the three subjects?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, pehle ye nikal ki Math/Physics kitne log pasand karte hain. Formula $A + B - Both$. $55 + 45 - 30 = 70\%$. Remaining kitne bache? $30\%$. Total 800 ka $30\% = 240$ students. Ab in remaining me se $25\%$ CS me gaye. No preference wale bache $75\%$ of these remaining. $240$ ka $75\%$ (yani $\frac{3}{4}$) nikal le. $\frac{3}{4} \times 240 = 180$ students.

Trick: Sequential percentages ko chain me step by step tod liya karo, Venn Diagram ke baad simple tree method hai.

Summary: 'Among the remaining' word me hamesha dhyaan rakhna, naya base create ho jata hai.

questions.q: In a group of 120 people, 54 like Coca-Cola and 84 like Pepsi and each person likes at least one beverages. How many like both Coca-Cola and Pepsi ?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, ye toh basic Venn diagram hai. Formula hamesha kaam karta hai: $n(A \cup B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A \cap B)$. Yaha har koi kuch na kuch pita hai, toh Union total 120 hi hoga. $120 = 54 + 84 - Both$. Solve kar: $Both = 138 - 120 = 18$. Ans aa gaya, itna sochna hi nahi hai.

Best Approach: Direct addition karke total me se minus kar do, common log nikal aate hain.

Summary: Jab overlap pakadna ho, individual totals ko jod kar overall limit se jitna upar gaya wahi overlap hota hai.

questions.q: Ridhi scored 65 marks in Mathematics. He scored $70\%$ marks in Hindi and $(X^3 + 20)$ marks in English. The maximum marks for each subject is 80. The overall percentage of marks obtained by Riddhi in all three subjects together is $70\%$. Find X?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, overall score $70\%$ hai 3 subjects par. Yani har subject me average 56 marks ($70\%$ of 80) hone chahiye! Hindi me toh pehle se 56 hain ($70\%$), isko side rakh. Math me 65 hain, yani average se +9 zyada laya. Average maintain karne ke liye English me 9 number kam lane padenge 56 se. English score hona chahiye $56 - 9 = 47$. Question bolta hai English $(X^3 + 20)$ hai. $X^3 + 20 = 47 \Rightarrow X^3 = 27$. Toh X=3. Boom!

Trick: Average deviation zindabad! Pura calculation kyu karein jab base barabar kar sakte hain.

Summary: Jab bhi percentages subject wise diye ho, total calculation chod kar deviation balance karna seekho, CGL me ye 30 seconds bachayega.

questions.q: A mixture contains $60\%$ milk. If 20 liters of water is added to the 80-liter mixture, what is the new percentage of milk? (CGL TIER I - $\frac{22}{09}$/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, ye toh sasta nashta hai! Milk ki actual volume pehle nikalo. 80 liter me $60\%$ milk hai yani 48 liter milk hai. Ab tumne 20 liter paani milaya. Total solution kitna ho gaya? $80 + 20 = 100$ liters. Lekin milk toh abhi bhi 48 liter hi hai na. Naya percentage = $\frac{48}{100} \times 100 = 48\%$.

Best Approach: Paani mila rahe ho toh constant term (Milk) dhundho aur bas total base change kardo.

Summary: Mixture me jo element chheda na jaye uski absolute value change naye total par lagana basic fundamental hai.
